# Future-school sample: Vanguard

Vanguard By T. Choonyung, downloaded from the signed-in Mixamo library on 2026-11-12. Original mesh and embedded textures retained. Mixamo motions: Idle (Standing Idle), Talking (General Conversation), Walking (Male Standard Walk, In Place enabled). Converted locally from FBX into GLB with Blender 4.5.12; animations named Idle, Talking, Walking. Current sample replaces Mia only; the robot coach and task logic remain unchanged. No facial morph targets were found in the converted model.

Source: https://www.mixamo.com/
Usage FAQ: https://helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html
Terms: https://wwwimages2.adobe.com/content/dam/cc/en/legal/servicetou/Mixamo-Addl-Terms-en_US-20210623.pdf
Licensed asset, not CC0. Raw FBX stays in local Downloads; generated GLB excluded from source commits. This iteration is local only.

# Current future-school sample: RobotExpressive (2026-11-12)

Used for the user-controlled student and the existing sample URL. Mia retains Vanguard. Model by Tomas Laulhe; modifications by Don McCurdy. License CC0 1.0 per upstream README. Original model and ready-made Idle, Walking and Wave animations used, no new animation generation. Wave is a greeting gesture, not talking lip sync.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive
